name: portfolio-manager-demo
description: Portfolio Manager - One command demo setup

scripts.demo:backend: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv -e .env.demo -- npm run start:dev
scripts.demo:setup: cd backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv -e .env.demo -- npm run demo:setup
scripts.demo:all: npm run demo:db:up && npm run demo:wait-db && concurrently -n "backend,setup" -c "blue,green" "npm run demo:backend" "npm run demo:wait-backend && npm run demo:setup" && echo Setup complete! Starting frontend... && npm run demo:frontend
